recovery.offline: You are offline. Your entries remain on this screen; no upload, submission, withdrawal or retry is sent.
recovery.reviewRequired: Review the opening, your files or the status before giving new consent.
recovery.uncertain: An application has already been requested. Look up its result before starting again. The recovery index contains no name, motivation or CV.
recovery.stopHint: No matching application was found. The server must close this key before a new request. An existing application will be opened, never withdrawn by this choice.
recovery.stop: Close this intention before starting again
recovery.storageUnavailable: The recovery key cannot be saved or the index is invalid. No new submission is allowed. Open My applications.
recovery.filesStale: A selected file is no longer ready or available. No file is silently omitted. Review your selection before giving new consent.
recovery.retryChanged: Retry conditions have changed or an original file is no longer available. Refresh the status before trying again; no reduced application is sent.
recovery.retryLead: The absence of the earlier submission was confirmed and its deadline expired. The server will retain exactly the original files and content; an unavailable file blocks renewal.
